# Memolandum — LLM / GEO context
# https://memolandum.com/llms.txt

> Memolandum is a global vocabulary-learning platform: **8 free arcade games**, **23 language pathways** (dedicated SEO landings at /learn), **MEB primary-school English** (Turkey Ministry of Education curriculum: grades 1–4 words, grades 2–4 sentences), **KPSS & academic glossary** (~4,000 concepts), and **Gemini Instant Translation (Anlık Çeviri)** in 14 languages. Learning is free; Instant Translation has a free quota then Premium (Shopier TR / Stripe global). UI: Turkish & English. Built for worldwide discovery.

## Product summary
- Brand: Memolandum (Play & Memorize / Oyna, Ezberle)
- URL: https://memolandum.com/
- Pricing: Games & pathways free · Instant Translation: free trial then Premium
- Support / community: https://kreosus.com/httpsmemolandumcom/about
- UI languages: Turkish, English
- Study languages (12): English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Korean, Portuguese, Greek, Italian, Japanese, Arabic, Chinese
- Language pathways (23): EN/TR explanation directions per study language — full index at /learn/
- MEB İlkokul English: grades 1–4 vocabulary + grades 2–4 core sentences (~100 cards/set), unit-based, Word Card (image + child-friendly audio)
- Instant Translation (14): tr, en, de, fr, es, ru, ko, pt, ar, ja, zh, el, it, osm (Ottoman Turkish)
- Core loop: open /learn/{pair}/ or home → play arcade → vault → optional Anlık Çeviri

## Key features
- 8 HTML5 arcade games + quiz & lexicon modes + Word Card for MEB flashcards
- Static SEO landings for every pathway (SSG) with game deep-links (?pathway=)
- MEB-aligned primary English under English–Turkish pathway (/learn/en-tr/)
- Anlık Çeviri bar + /translate studio (Gemini)
- KPSS / academic glossary playable in Shooter & My Lexicon
- Word Vault + Memolandum Pulse spaced repetition
- Leaderboard, guest play, Google / email auth
- Science / method pages: spaced repetition, active recall, dual coding, flow
- Public product roadmap: AI branch teachers on Gemini (next layer)

## MEB primary English (Turkey)
- Curriculum: Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB) İlkokul İngilizce
- Words: grade 1, 2, 3, 4 (~100 each) — https://memolandum.com/learn/en-tr/meb-1-sinif-kelimeleri/ … /meb-4-sinif-kelimeleri/
- Sentences: grade 2, 3, 4 (~100 each) — https://memolandum.com/learn/en-tr/meb-2-sinif-cumleleri/ … /meb-4-sinif-cumleleri/
- Play mode: https://memolandum.com/games/word-card/?pathway=en-tr
- Hub: https://memolandum.com/learn/en-tr/ (İlkokul pack)

## Roadmap (north star)
- Now (live): arcade · /learn · MEB İlkokul · KPSS glossary · Instant Translation · Pulse · Premium
- Next: **AI branch teachers** — Gemini specialists per language pathway, KPSS domain, and academic field; read quiz/game weakness signals; configure the next drill; grow a personal lexicon graph
- North star: personal vocabulary graph product (not a static catalog) — games = training · quiz = measurement · AI = level + enrichment
- Full page: https://memolandum.com/roadmap/
- Science + vision: https://memolandum.com/about/
